#!/bin/ash
# Velocity Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server

cd /mnt/server

USER_AGENT="pterodactyl-panel/1.0 (https://github.com/pterodactyl/panel)"

# PaperMC sunset the v2 API in favour of the "fill" v3 API, which requires a
# descriptive User-Agent. Versions are grouped newest-first with snapshots listed
# before their stable release, so scan them in order and take the first version
# that has a STABLE build, skipping snapshot builds so installs always get the
# latest stable release.
VERSIONS="$(curl -s --max-time 30 -H "User-Agent: ${USER_AGENT}" https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/velocity | jq -r '.versions | to_entries[] | .value[]')"

for VERSION in $VERSIONS; do
    BUILDS="$(curl -s --max-time 30 -H "User-Agent: ${USER_AGENT}" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/velocity/versions/${VERSION}/builds")"

    # If this version's build list is unavailable (PaperMC purges old builds and
    # prunes snapshot trains regularly), skip it and try the next version.
    API_ERROR="$(echo "${BUILDS}" | jq -r 'if (type == "object" and .ok == false) then .message else "ok" end')"
    if [ "${API_ERROR}" != "ok" ]; then
        echo "Skipping Velocity ${VERSION}: ${API_ERROR:-unknown API error}" 1>&2
        continue
    fi

    DOWNLOAD_URL="$(echo "${BUILDS}" | jq -r 'first(.[] | select(.channel == "STABLE" and (.downloads."server:default".url | contains("SNAPSHOT") | not)) | .downloads."server:default".url) // "null"')"
    SHA256="$(echo "${BUILDS}" | jq -r 'first(.[] | select(.channel == "STABLE" and (.downloads."server:default".url | contains("SNAPSHOT") | not)) | .downloads."server:default".checksums.sha256) // ""')"

    if [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" != "null" ]; then
        break
    fi
done

if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" == "null" ]; then
    echo "No stable Velocity release is available from the PaperMC API."
    exit 1
fi

echo -e "Downloading Velocity ${VERSION}..."
curl -f -o ${SERVER_JARFILE}.tmp "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" || { echo "Download failed."; exit 2; }

# Verify the download against the checksum published by the API before
# promoting it into place. A mismatch means the artifact is not what PaperMC
# published, so the install fails and the temporary file is removed.
if [ -n "${SHA256}" ]; then
    if ! (echo "${SHA256}  ${SERVER_JARFILE}.tmp" | sha256sum -c - > /dev/null 2>&1); then
        echo "Checksum mismatch for ${SERVER_JARFILE}; aborting install."
        rm -f ${SERVER_JARFILE}.tmp
        exit 3
    fi
fi

mv ${SERVER_JARFILE}.tmp ${SERVER_JARFILE}

echo -e "Install Complete"
